craft_notes: Sthāyin: body-churn (tissue-list as delusion-house). Rows: row 1 (frame uncut — the tissue list never split). Close: greatness (māhātmya as landing: blind TO it). Rejected: trimming the tissue list — kept all six (the catalogue IS the contemplation); 'save us' — kept drown (majjati as plunge, no rescue implied).

lines: Māyā, you drown the knowing and the unknowing, blind to your greatness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvagrudhiramāṃsamedomajjāsthimaye sadāmaye kāye | māye majjayasi tvaṃ māhātmyaṃ te janānajānānān

reads_against.argmap: Whom does Māyā plunge? → The body catalogued as delusion's house; knowing and unknowing alike plunged for not knowing her greatness.
c1_essence: Body catalogued as delusion's house; knowing and unknowing alike plunged for not knowing her greatness.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder worked into rest)
